sandbox: existing app-private Lua5.4 environment; no require or filesystem; one UI module per VM

ui_help.label: Draw transparent text in a top-left box. options.width is the alignment/clipping box width, not a right edge. Example: label(10,70,"Hei",{width=300,align="center",font="ui16"}).
ui_help.buttons: Draw bottom labels in physical LEFT A, MIDDLE B, RIGHT C order at y=211. focused is "A", "B" or "C". Bind those exact actions in on_button; nil omits a label.
ui_help.button: Draw a button only; it does not read input, register handlers or change app state.
ui_help.menu: Draw strings or {label=...} items with a 1-based selected index and automatic paging. It does not process input.
ui_help.navigate: Return updated 1-based index and selected boolean for a short button press: index,chosen=ui.navigate(index,button,count). A previous, C next, B chosen. App implements the chosen action.
ui_help.toggle: Draw the supplied boolean state only; app toggles it in its own handler.
ui_help.checkbox: Draw the supplied boolean state only; app changes it in its own handler.
ui_help.selector: Draw label/value and focus only; app owns value changes.
ui_help.dialog: Draw title/message plus left cancel and right confirm controls; bind and label their A/B/C actions explicitly. Does not block, wait or handle input.
ui_help.pause: Draw a pause dialog with Avslutt/Fortsett. App owns paused state and binds the visible actions; keep rendering every update.
ui_help.game_menu: Draw Start/Innstillinger/Tilbake and previous/select/next labels. Implement all three entries, or use menu with your own actual entries.
ui_help.game_over: Draw score/best and A Tilbake/B Igjen. Implement A and B explicitly.
ui_help.timer: Draw HH:MM:SS from non-negative milliseconds. App owns elapsed time and state; ui.timer does not start or advance a timer.
ui_help.clock: Draw hour:minute with optional :second. x/y is the top-left of the text alignment box.
ui_help.sprite: Draw a canonical asset ID or animation ID alien.walk/coin.spin/flag.wave. milliseconds drives animation; scale is integer. App owns position and simulation.
ui_help.theme: Return current app-private palette or a named palette: bg,panel,fg,muted,accent,good,bad,border. Other color field names do not exist.
ui_help.set_theme: Select an existing named theme for this app. Shared native bitmap data remain unchanged.
ui_help.layout: Return x,y,w,h composition coordinates for a 1-based slot. instrument returns center x,y and radius-sized slots; this is geometry, not an interactive screen.
ui_help.ring: value is fraction 0..1. x/y is center and r radius. Label is optional; thickness must be 1..r.
ui_help.progress: value is fraction 0..1. Draw only; app updates value.
ui_help.gauge: value uses minimum..maximum; x/y is center and r radius. Draw only; app owns measurement.
ui_help.line_chart: Draw at most 64 numeric values as one bounded polyline plus panel. Minimum and maximum set vertical scale.
ui_help.bar_chart: Draw at most 16 numeric values, scaled from zero to maximum.
ui_help.screen: Clear current frame and draw title/subtitle. Call before scene content, every update. It never presents or schedules frames.
ui_help.card: Draw label, value and optional detail/icon. Keep short text inside the card; x/y is top-left.
ui_help.burst: Append at most 16 bounded particles; use a persistent app table and call only when an event occurs.
ui_help.particles: Advance/draw at most 16 particles; dt is milliseconds. Call every update while particles are active.

sprite.tint: optional RGB565; ignored for non-tintable assets
